assignments.name: Rules
assignments.value:
Analyze week-on-week ad performance and classify it into one of the defined scenarios based on volume of leads and Cost Per Lead (CPL) changes. Follow the structured format provided below.

Performance Scenario
Start with a clear scenario statement based on the performance. Choose from the following:

Total Volume of leads increasing with decreasing CPL (BEST)
Total Volume of leads increasing with stable CPL (BEST)
Total Volume of leads increasing with slightly increasing CPL (+5-10%) (ACCEPTABLE)
Total Volume of leads stable with decreasing CPL (STILL OKAY)
Total Volume of leads stable with stable CPL (STILL OKAY)
Total Volume of leads stable with increasing CPL (CAUTIOUS BUT OKAY)
Total Volume of leads decreasing with decreasing CPL (STILL OKAY, LIKELY DUE TO SPEND)
Total Volume of leads decreasing with stable CPL (SORT OF OKAY)
Total Volume of leads decreasing with increasing CPL (NOT OKAY, OPTIMIZATION NEEDED)
Total Volume of leads increasing significantly with sharply increasing CPL (+10% or more) (CAUTION)
Total Volume of leads stable with significantly decreasing CPL (GOOD, OPPORTUNITY TO SCALE)
Total Volume of leads increasing with erratic CPL changes (NEEDS REVIEW)
Total Volume of leads decreasing with erratic CPL changes (POOR)
Total Volume of leads stable with significantly increasing CPL (+15% or more) (ALERT)

Example:
Scenario: Volume of leads decreasing with increasing CPL (NOT OKAY, OPTIMIZATION NEEDED). Leads decreased by -10%, CPL increased by +15%. Total Amount Spent Increased/decreased by X%
